LESSON: PRESERVING ANIMAL PRODUCTS • MILK • MEAT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.5: Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat, part of Food Production Processes in Grade 8 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we preserve milk and meat at household level?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the importance of preserving milk and meat at household level,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. preserve meat to prolong shelf life at household level,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. preserve milk to prolong shelf life at household level,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. embrace the use of various methods to preserve animal products at household level. Learners are guided to: • search for information from digital and print resources, discuss and share experiences on the importance of preserving milk and meat at household level, • preserve milk through methods such as boiling, fermenting and home cooling techniques, • preserve meat through methods such as salting, boiling, drying and smoking, • make presentations to promote applicable methods of preserving animal products to embrace their use at household level, How can we preserve milk and meat at household level?

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.

D. embrace the use of various methods to preserve animal products at household level. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology as learners search for information on milk and meat preservation.

Values:
Integrity: honesty in the process of preserving meat and milk using ethically acceptable procedures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Food hygiene as learners ensure use of clean equipment and appropriate environment in the preservation of meat and milk.

Link to other learning areas:

Learners relate preservation of meat and milk to basic principles of preservation learnt in Integrated Science.
